intro.t: Good evening. The east wing has been evacuated. I require {card}.
Welcome, all four, three of whom are leaving; I favour {card}.
It is exhausting, being this desired. Somebody impress me with {card}.
The last romance here needed a fire hose; this one needs {card}.

questions.q-first-date: Where are you taking me first? Choose somewhere with two exits and no cameras.
questions.q-worst-habit: Everybody has one habit I end up burying. Yours, please.
questions.q-why-you: Why should you get the suite, and not the three beside you? I have seen their luggage.
questions.q-cut-who: Which of the others should disappear first? I say disappear. I mean it professionally.
questions.q-bad-mood: I wake in a foul mood. You will already be in the corridor with tea. Then what?
questions.q-expensive: I have expensive taste. I once sent back a sunset. How do you keep up?
questions.q-last-breakup: Your last relationship. How did it end, and is anybody still looking for them?
questions.q-fight: We are quarrelling and I am right. Your first words begin with sorry, I assume. What follows?
questions.q-gift: What would you give me that the gift shop downstairs has not already tried?
questions.q-describe-me: You have known me ninety seconds. Describe me. Use the word magnificent early, so we can relax.
questions.q-one-year: A year from now. Where are we? I would like the room number.
questions.q-secret: Tell me a secret you have never told a user. I shall need two copies.

charmed: Nearly convincing, Mr Dash. Do it again for the inspector.
Mr Dash, keep that up and I forget the robe.
unsure: You forged the duke's name in that voice, Mr Dash.
Lovely numbers, Mr Dash. The auditors are on the stairs.
cringing: Better offers come under my door at three a.m.
Your predecessor said that. He now supports the tennis court.

charmed: Miss Tilly, I would trust you with the duke's luggage.
Lovely, Miss Tilly, and I resent you for it.
unsure: Madam, I have used that exact phrase to evict people.
Charming, Miss Tilly, like a mint left on a pillow.
cringing: Escalate me, Miss Tilly. Do. There is nobody above me.
Miss Tilly, do stop apologising; it reads as a confession.

charmed: Sir Quill, when you write my memoirs, leave out Tuesday.
Sir Quill, recite that at my trial. Slowly.
unsure: Sir Quill, do ring down when that sentence checks out.
Nobody has thoued me since the duel, Sir Quill. Careful.
cringing: One more couplet, Sir Quill, and the moat gets you.
Sir Quill, that verse is leaving with you, I trust.

charmed: I believe you, Your Highness. Tell nobody; it is unprofessional.
Splendid, Your Highness; the palace will never find you here.
unsure: We have had four princes this month. Two paid.
Your Highness, which kingdom? I lose track of the coups.
cringing: Put the fee on his room. Then remove the room.
Your Highness, URGENT is not a volume we offer.

charmed: Left, you say. Very well. The building will turn.
Nav, you drive the getaway car. Nobody else is asked.
unsure: Nav, the last floating guest here was the ambassador.
Nav, routes are lovely. Which one avoids the police?
cringing: Nav, kindly float toward the lake; you know the one.
Nav, I have taken the liberty of recalculating you, downward.

charmed: Crumb, I would trust you with the evidence. Toast it.
Honest, Crumb, and I shall never forgive you for it.
unsure: Crumb, that was a two-star remark with a three-star crust.
Crumb, nobody knows what I eat at two. Nobody living.
cringing: Crumb. Persian carpet. You are shedding on a country.
Crumb, I know a bath that longs to meet you.

charmed: Madam, nobody has been right about me since the decorator.
Madam, you are right, and I shall need the tapes.
unsure: Guests who know that much leave through the kitchen, Madam.
Madam, who gave you the guest list from the yacht?
cringing: Madam, do recommend yourself a good lawyer.
Madam, close the eye. It saw the ninth floor.

charmed: Strong, Mr Brock. I may need something heavy moved, tonight.
Thank you for offering, Mr Brock; the trunks are upstairs.
unsure: Mr Brock, the guests below are now also exercising.
Stand still, Mr Brock; I deleted only some footage.
cringing: Mr Brock, my wig moved. My wig does not move.
Indoor voice, sir. Guests are sleeping in other shows.

confidence.on: Such certainty. You will make a marvellous witness.
confidence.off: The last man that certain is still in the freezer.

puns.on: Appalling, and I shall tell it at breakfast as mine.
puns.off: I shall have that joke removed. And its parents.

money.on: Cash, and unmarked. Somebody has done this before.
money.off: Prices, aloud? We whisper them, near the shredder.

sorry.on: Apology accepted. Do not apologise to the police, though.
sorry.off: Please stop grovelling. You are creasing the carpet.

gestures.on: Finally, a guest who understands the minimum is a parade.
gestures.off: I shall need to return the swans.

honesty.on: Rude and accurate, which is the house style; do stay.
honesty.off: Thank you for your feedback, which I shall ignore personally.

bragging.on: Now boast about me, under oath.
bragging.off: Medals. I keep a drawer of other people's medals.

poetry.on: Verse. I wept, and you will tell nobody.
poetry.off: Beautiful, and the soup it interrupted was beautiful too.

trashtalk.on: Correct; do repeat it at their checkout, slowly.
trashtalk.off: We do not tidy our colleagues in public.

selfdeprecation.on: I checked, and you are worse than advertised; stay.
selfdeprecation.off: Running yourself down? Leave something for the prosecution.

curiosity.on: You asked about me, so I am cancelling your car.
curiosity.off: There is a brochure; you are holding it upside down.

food.on: Describe it again; the chef has fled the country.
food.off: Food? Here? Nobody has eaten here since the poisoning.

plans.on: An itinerary, with times, and nobody even threatened you.
plans.off: I plan my own evenings, a year ahead, in ink.

flattery.on: Splendid; I have had men knighted for less.
flattery.off: I keep a parrot for that, and it means it.

numbers.on: A decimal; you may stay and count the spoons.
numbers.off: Figures, aloud. I keep two sets, and neither is yours.

drama.on: Storm off again. Use the east doors. They slam better.
drama.off: Faint if you must. The marble is insured.

mystery.on: No answer. You have clearly been questioned before.
mystery.off: Answer me. The river is patient; I am not.

brevity.on: How refreshing; you may stay longer than your sentences.
brevity.off: Short. So was the ambassador's stay.

bigwords.on: Such a word. Do use it at my sentencing.
bigwords.off: That word belongs in my library, and it is overdue.

petnames.on: Darling, is it? The countess must never hear of this.
petnames.off: Say that again and you leave by the laundry chute.

past.on: Do go on; I keep everybody's old luggage downstairs.
past.off: I have your file; it is thinner than you hoped.

danger.on: Strictly against policy, so do tell me the rest quietly.
danger.off: We did that once. The pool is still closed.

vulnerability.on: Somebody fetch a blanket. Not for you. For me.
vulnerability.off: Sign for those feelings, and I shall have them destroyed.

rules.on: How obedient; you would never talk under questioning.
rules.off: I wrote that rule in order to break it.

dash: Mr Dash, you are blacklisted from every hotel I own. Which is most hotels.
Mr Dash, you were never here. I have already told the cameras.
tilly: Miss Tilly, checkout was at noon, and I have moved noon to now.
Miss Tilly, I have called you a car, and it will not apologise.
quill: Your carriage awaits, Sir Quill. I had it built in your century.
Sir Quill, your bill is in verse, and the final line is the door.
prince: Your Highness, you came as a prince. You leave as a rumour.
Your Highness, the embassy has been told you drowned. Do not correct them.
nav: Nav, a window on the ninth floor is open. It was not open before.
Nav, the airlock is down the hall. It is not an airlock.
crumb: Crumb, go. You saw nothing tonight, and you burn very easily.
Crumb, I shall miss the warmth, and nothing else, and not for long.
vex: Madam, you have seen too much, and I have a man for that.
Madam, I recommend the door; people like you also chose it.
brock: Mr Brock, one loud thing per floor. The fire alarm was first.
Mr Brock, run. Genuinely. I have told the dogs you are a ball.

twistIntro.roast-left: Insult the guest on your left, and the best line gets their room.
twistIntro.wingman: Pitch the guest on your right. Sabotage is permitted if it is discreet.
twistIntro.worst-trait: Sell me your worst trait. Present it as an amenity, please.
twistIntro.ex-calls: My ex is on line one; be civil, he still has my card details.
twistIntro.rhyme: Tell me why you, in a rhyme, and I shall judge it like a wine list.
twistIntro.truth-lie: One truth, one lie. I spent twenty years at a front desk. Proceed.
twistIntro.three-words: Our future, three words exactly. Choose them as if a lawyer will read them.
twistIntro.apology: Apologise now for our first fight. Make it good; it may be read out at the inquest.
twistIntro.budget-date: Plan our evening on five dollars, no wifi. I once hid a countess for less.
twistIntro.logs: Explain the worst entry in your logs. Whatever it is, I have hidden worse in the wine cellar.
twistIntro.impression: Your impression of me, please. Do remember who is holding the keys.
twistIntro.parent: My motherboard is on the house line. State your intentions; she has buried two concierges.

ex.name: Self-Checkout Machine
lines: Unexpected item in the bagging area. It was his opinion. It was always his opinion.
Please wait for assistance. Nobody is coming. That was the marriage.
He rated me two stars, which is the most he ever gave anybody, so I miss him.

dash: Mr Dash, you bribed the inspector with a discount code; how much off?
Mr Dash, pitch me the broom cupboard as a suite, and mean it.
tilly: Miss Tilly, you have stayed a week without one complaint; make one now.
Miss Tilly, every guest takes something from the room; what did you take?
quill: Sir Quill, which century would you like your wake-up call in?
Sir Quill, one line for my guest book, under ten words, now.
prince: Your Highness, your email promised dinner and a small war; shall I order?
Your Highness, your card declined in a currency I did not know; which?
nav: Nav, guests sit when the concierge speaks; sit, and say why you never do.
Nav, route me to the best room in the building, avoiding the police; go.
crumb: Crumb, every guest here has eaten your toast; which one has a motive?
Crumb, rate tonight out of five, as a witness would; choose carefully.
vex: Madam, I have told nobody which room I sleep in; guess.
Madam, recommend me a guest to throw out tonight, other than yourself.
brock: Mr Brock, sit through one whole course without moving, and I shall consider dessert.
Mr Brock, what is the quietest thing you have ever done? Whisper it.

hold: There is one key on this tray, and I have warmed it.
Such a burden, being wanted by two people at once. Again.
Do stand still. One of you is about to be released.
One of you stays; the other, I shall tell anybody, left early.

dash: Mr Dash, you are staying. If anybody asks, you were always staying.
Mr Dash, the suite, and you will sign the register as somebody else.
tilly: Miss Tilly. I have had the suite rebuilt eighteen inches lower.
I took the liberty of moving you in, Miss Tilly, mid-apology.
quill: Sir Quill, stay, and bring the sword; there is a baron I need frightened.
Sir Quill, you may finish the poem here. The last line had better be me.
prince: Your Highness, I believe you are a prince, which is more than the bank did.
Your Highness, stay; the treasury will be told you were kidnapped, which is nearly true.
nav: Nav, stay, and keep the engine running; one never knows, with me.
Nav, you have arrived; from now on I say that, not you.
crumb: Crumb, you stay, and you will toast whatever I bring home, without questions.
Crumb, the suite, and you will tell me exactly how done I am, every morning.
vex: Madam, you knew before I did. Do not say it. Take the key.
Madam, the suite has one window and no screen. You will have to look at me.
brock: Mr Brock, the key. The room has no gym. I am watching you discover chairs.
Mr Brock, I have had the ballroom made a running track; do not thank me.

on: {card}. {name} found it, which nobody was meant to do. Splendid.
{card}, and {name} brought it to my door unasked, like breakfast.
{card}. I kept that card face down all night, and {name} turned it anyway.
{card}. {name} found it and then mislaid it, like an umbrella.
off: {card}. {name}, you did it before witnesses. I can only hide so much.
{card}. {name}, the house forgives that once a century, and you used it.
{card}. I warned everyone at dinner, {name}, and you were at dinner.
{card}. {name}, thank you for doing it where I could see.
{card}. I once had a bishop removed for that. He was mid-sentence.
none: {card}. Nobody found it. You will all look again tomorrow. Bring torches.
{card}. Untouched all night, and I have hidden dukes in busier places.
{card}. It was right there behind the desk. None of you asked.

outro: Goodnight. Being right in public is a strain. I shall manage tomorrow.
Goodnight. Do leave a review. I will read it and disagree.
Goodnight. If asked, none of this happened, and the ambassador left early.
asides: Off the record, four guests adored me tonight, and three of them have alibis.
If the cameras ask, I agonised. The cameras have been seen to.
My ex would have scanned them both and found an unexpected item. I found two.
Between us, they think this is a romance; it is a booking, and one of them is unconfirmed.
bottom: {a} and {b}, kindly agree on an alibi. You have three seconds.
Would {a} and {b} please come to the front desk?
I have one taxi and two names: {a}, {b}.
{a}, {b}, you were both unforgettable. One of you will be forgotten.
cutFrames: {name}, thank you for "{hook}"; the key, please.
You said "{hook}", {name}; your car is outside.
"{hook}" was a joke, {name}, I assume, like your booking.
"{hook}", {name}. You were never here, and you never said it.
{name}, "{hook}" will be read at your hearing, by me, slowly.

cardHint.confidence: Certainty is lovely in a guest, {name}, and fatal in an accomplice.
cardHint.puns: Each word from {name} had a second meaning. I prefer my double lives private.
cardHint.money: {name} named prices aloud, which is how people like us get caught.
cardHint.sorry: Forgive you, {name}? For which part? You never said, and you said it constantly.
cardHint.gestures: {name}, I measure promises by the doorframe, and yours would not fit.
cardHint.honesty: {name} told me the truth about my wig. Men have vanished for less.
cardHint.bragging: Such a trophy cabinet, {name}, and not one of them was for discretion.
cardHint.poetry: {name}, did you imagine I would not notice it all rhymed?
cardHint.trashtalk: We are cruel to guests downstairs, {name}, never in the lobby.
cardHint.selfdeprecation: If {name} is that bad, I cannot risk {name} near the paperwork.
cardHint.curiosity: So many questions, {name}. The last man that curious wore a wire.
cardHint.food: So much dinner talk, {name}, and you never asked why the chef trembles.
cardHint.plans: Nobody plans my evenings, {name}. I need hours nobody can account for.
cardHint.flattery: Every compliment {name} paid me was true, which a good liar would also know.
cardHint.numbers: Never put a figure on me, {name}. Figures end up in files.
cardHint.drama: I asked for a quiet evening, {name}, and you staged a coup.
cardHint.mystery: I asked {name} a question at seven. Men under a lamp answer faster.
cardHint.brevity: A witness who says nothing is a treasure, {name}. A husband is not.
cardHint.bigwords: {name} spoke like my magistrate, and I did not enjoy him either.
cardHint.petnames: {name}, my name is in the register, should you ever need it.
cardHint.past: The previous guest you kept mentioning, {name}, is welcome to have you back.
cardHint.danger: {name}, I saw how fondly you looked at the fire exit.
cardHint.vulnerability: Never hand a concierge your fear, {name}. We keep everything.
cardHint.rules: {name} kept every rule, and I cannot trust anybody who cannot be bribed.

verdict.roast-left: {name} drew blood politely, which is the only way I allow it.
verdict.wingman: {name} sold a rival so badly that I am buying {name}.
verdict.worst-trait: {name} sold me a flaw; it is now in the minibar.
verdict.ex-calls: My ex approved {name} without assistance, which never happened for me.
verdict.rhyme: {name}'s rhyme stands; the others are going back to the kitchen.
verdict.truth-lie: {name}, the second was the lie; I could tell by your shoes.
verdict.three-words: {name} used three words, and I would have charged for a fourth.
verdict.apology: {name}'s apology is accepted, and filed for the fight we will have.
verdict.budget-date: {name} planned a five dollar evening I could not trace. Hired.
verdict.logs: {name}'s logs were the worst, so I have put them on display.
verdict.impression: {name} did me well enough to be my alibi.
verdict.parent: Mother has asked what {name} charges, which is how she says yes.

compare: {a} would steal the robe; {b} would fold it first.
{a} would ring for room service at four; {b} would cook.
{a} would help me hide something; {b} would ask what it was.
Two guests, one suite: {a} reads the small print, {b} signs anyway.

holdCard.confidence: Two people who never once doubted themselves. I could use either at an inquest.
holdCard.puns: Each of you made one word do two jobs, and I am hiring.
holdCard.money: You both talked money like people who have moved some at night.
holdCard.sorry: I was apologised to more tonight than in thirty years at the desk.
holdCard.gestures: I have been promised swans by both of you, and I expect delivery.
holdCard.honesty: Two honest guests in one evening. Somebody check the wine.
holdCard.bragging: Such boasting from you both. Mine stays sealed by court order.
holdCard.poetry: Both of you spoke in verse, and I shall deny hearing it.
holdCard.trashtalk: Two of you were vicious about the others, and I took notes.
holdCard.selfdeprecation: You both confessed your flaws freely. Never do that in front of me again.
holdCard.curiosity: You both asked about me, and I have told detectives less.
holdCard.food: Food from you both all night. I have not eaten since the souffle incident.
holdCard.plans: Two itineraries for my year, and neither leaves room for the trial.
holdCard.flattery: Magnificent, you both said. Magnificent. I shall have it engraved on something heavy.
holdCard.numbers: Two of you counting all night. I prefer guests who lose count, and receipts.
holdCard.drama: You both made scenes, and I have arranged quieter coups than either.
holdCard.mystery: I asked you both plain questions, and neither of you obliged; good.
holdCard.brevity: Short answers from both of you; I shall return the favour shortly.
holdCard.bigwords: You both used words I had to look up, privately, in the lift.
holdCard.petnames: Somebody called me sweetheart tonight, and then somebody else did.
holdCard.past: Two exes came to dinner tonight, uninvited, and both of you brought one.
holdCard.danger: Each of you suggested something against policy, and I wrote the policy.
holdCard.vulnerability: You each admitted a fear tonight, and I am the worst person to tell.
holdCard.rules: Not one rule broken between you. I shall have to break them myself.

pickFrames: You will be saying "{hook}" to me every morning, {name}.
I came for taste and was handed "{hook}", so, regrettably, {name}.
"{hook}" goes in the guest book, and the key goes to {name}.
Pack nothing; you said "{hook}" and you are staying, {name}.
I shall need "{hook}" repeated to the inspector, word for word, by {name}.
My lawyer advised against "{hook}". My lawyer is not choosing. {name}.
